wiki.title: Jill Billings
wiki.extract: Jill Elizabeth Billings (born January 19, 1962) is an American Democratic politician and retired educator from La Crosse, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 95th Assembly district since November 2011. She is also a former member of the La Crosse County Board of Supervisors.
